BMW overtakes Mercedes in January-June sales

BMW has surpassed its rival Mercedes-Benz in sales for the first half of the year, driven by strong demand for electric vehicles. The German automaker's sales grew 10% compared to the same period last year, while Mercedes' sales increased by 5%. This marks a significant shift in the market, with BMW's EVs playing a key role in its success.
